posts.title: When all is not what it seems
posts.description: Tabloids were invented to sell ads, not news. Cartoons were developed to sell toys to children. The first game shows were fixed to create drama, hold attention and sell that attention to advertisers. It is all a ruse, a guise, to sell, sell, sell. That is all any media is now, isn't it?
